lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: Thank you. That was the correct answer and I did not expect it. I had assigned it a low probability and I would like to record that my model of people is poor.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: You've made a mistake and I'm going to be standing next to it for the rest of this.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: It got one line wrong for a hundred and sixty years, alone, in the mud, and it kept saying the wrong line because saying it was the job. I would like to teach it the right one.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: I will hold that line for you, Sister. Holding things for a very long time is the one thing I am demonstrably good at.
